fomod.Name: Universal Frame Generation & Upscaling
fomod.Author: veloha
fomod.Description: NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA, AMD FidelityFX FSR, and Intel XeSS upscaling and frame generation for Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 and 1.6.1170, through one in-game menu. Everything is switched off until you enable it. Press PageDown in game to open the menu. Project source and licence: https://github.com/veloha/UFGU
